description: This file defines the RuntimeLoaderInterface within the Twig templating engine, specifying a method to create runtime implementations for Twig elements such as filters, functions, and tests.

classes.name: RuntimeLoaderInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for classes responsible for creating runtime implementations of Twig elements.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates the runtime implementation of a Twig element (filter, function, test) given its class name. Returns an object or null if not supported.
